# Code of Conduct

The Industrial Mathematics Group adopts the **[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/)** as the code of conduct for all its repositories, issue trackers, discussions and other project spaces.

In short: be respectful and constructive, assume good intent, welcome newcomers, and focus criticism on ideas and code, never on people. Harassment and discriminatory behaviour are not tolerated.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behaviour, contact the maintainers at **dev@blackslash.win**. Reports are handled confidentially. The maintainers may take any action they consider appropriate, as described in the enforcement guidelines of the Contributor Covenant.
